events.text: You lay the last piece of jade beside the others and the characters run together across the cracks like water finding its old bed. A whole volume. You read it once standing up and once sitting down, and the second time your energy follows the words without being asked.

effects.log: You practise until the sea of clouds goes dark under you.

choices.text: Copy it onto a fresh slip first

effects.log: You copy every character. A volume that took so long to gather should never be lost again.

events.text: An archivist of the Jade Court checks the joined volume against the catalogue and looks up at you with new interest. "Three people in ten thousand years have put that one back together," she says. "Two of them were already famous."

effects.log: She tells you. One of them is still alive.

choices.text: Thank her and go and practise

effects.log: You go. She writes your name in the catalogue beside the volume.

events.text: For years your breath has stopped at the same place, like a river at a dam. Tonight it does not stop. It goes on, past the place the method always ended, into country nobody wrote down, and you follow it with your eyes shut.

choices.text: Follow it as far as it goes

effects.log: It goes a long way. When you open your eyes the clouds have turned twice.

choices.text: Mark the place and come back to it

effects.log: You mark it in your mind like a cairn on a pass. Tomorrow you will go further.

events.text: The method you have breathed for centuries changes under you without asking, the way an old tree puts out a branch in a direction nobody expected. The archivists of the Court will want to hear of it.

effects.log: They write it down as a new variant, with your name beside it.
It is yours. They can find their own.

events.text: The jade slip is cool under your hand and the characters on it are in your own writing. Nobody taught you this method. Nobody could have. It is the shape of every breath you have taken above the clouds.

choices.text: Breathe it for the first time

effects.log: The first breath is like coming home to a house you built yourself.

choices.text: Read it aloud, once, to the clouds

effects.log: The clouds are polite. They do not interrupt.

events.text: Word goes round the Isles that someone has written a new immortal method, and by the end of the month there are visitors at your grotto: archivists, elders of three orders, and one very young immortal who only wants to look at you.

effects.log: Your grotto is very crowded for a week. You do not let anyone copy the slip.
You show the young one a single breath of it. They will remember it all their life.
